control_plan.implementation_approach: Model the effective window as two optional UTC millisecond boundaries, effective_from_ms and effective_until_ms. Add pointer fields to the CTL transport request and response types, map them to the corresponding OpenClaw cron job fields in mapAutomationSchedule, include them in cron.add params, and include changed or explicitly cleared values in cron.update patches. Validate that both values are positive when supplied and reject an empty or reversed window, while leaving manual cron.run behavior unchanged. No database migration is needed because the gateway remains the source of truth for cron jobs. In the frontend, add optional start/end datetime-local controls to the automation form, initialize them from existing jobs, convert between local datetime input and UTC milliseconds, allow either boundary to be omitted, and include only changed values in edit requests. Keep the window independent of the cron expression so recurring schedules continue to use their existing frequency and the window only constrains when the automation is active.
